answer: An identity whose pattern breaks is denied new nectar until it repeats the same verified behaviour for a full epoch, with each past relic of activity checked against the current record. To sybil at scale, an attacker must pay per identity in ongoing compute, storage, and real work each epoch, a cost as durable as carved marble rather than a one-time fee. Estimate: S1 140, S2 190, S3 180 = 510. Too long.
